To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the value of big data applications lies in the ability of companies to extract valuable information from the data and use it to make informed decisions, and the business model of big data applications is based on selling this information to customers and/or using this information to make profit.

big data applications are developed to solve a specific problem and to provide a specific value proposition for a specific customer segment, and they use big data as a key enabler to provide that value.

big data applications are deployed in different sectors and they have different business models which are based on the value that these applications provide to their customers and how they make profit out of it.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the business models of big data applications and how they can be leveraged to gain competitive advantages in different sectors.
the business models that can be used in big data applications.
the question of “how to build a successful business model for big data applications?”.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
big data applications can be categorized into three main types based on the type of data used in their business model: (i) data-driven, (ii) data-enabled, and (iii) data-exposed applications.
big data applications have a great impact on business models and they can be a great source of revenue for companies.
big data is not only a technological challenge but also a business challenge that requires new business models.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
big data applications are not only about data processing and analytics, but also about the way they are used to create value for the business and customers.
the business model canvas is a powerful tool that helps to understand how big data applications work and how these applications can be developed to be profitable.
big data is a key driver for business model innovation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
big data can be a key driver in the success of a business model.
big data can be used to improve the existing products and services, to create new ones and/or to create new revenue streams.
big data applications can provide significant value to their customers, but the way they do this varies from one sector to another.
